use_case_summary: Small SMB-focused support platform. Wants hosted API to replace in-house NLU for ticket summarization, structured JSON outputs (fields: summary, priority, tags, suggested-assignee), and tool-calling to create/update tickets in their system. Primary goals: reduce manual triage, shorten time-to-first-response, keep per-ticket cost < $0.10 on average.
requirements_detail: workload: mixed - live agent assist (streaming desirable) + batch nightly summarization
latency target: <150ms tail for agent-assist responses; 500ms OK for batch summarization
throughput: steady ~15-30 reqs/sec during peak; spikes up to 120 reqs/sec (short bursts)
model preference: pref open/quantized variants; ability to route to cheaper reranking model for low-cost bulk summaries
structured output: strict JSON schema enforcement and validation hooks; need examples and failure handling
tool calling: must call internal ticket-API to create/transfer tickets and fetch customer context (OAuth flow)
cost sensitivity: high - startup budget, wants clear unit economics and suggestions from Redwood Optimize
data controls: retention controls + audit logging required; prefer single-tenant log access but ok with hosted if SOC2 and audit logs provided
